title: Audit dimension (messaging, conversion, seo, ux-technical, design, security)
description: One rated area of the audit: a verdict, a weighted rubric, findings and strengths. The same shape is used by messaging.json, conversion.json, seo.json, ux-technical.json, design.json and security.json. Two rules a schema cannot express: rubric weights must add up to 100, and every finding key must be unique across all dimension files.

verdict.description: One or two sentences summing up the area.

rubric.description: One row per criterion. Weights are whole numbers and must sum to 100.

findings.description: Problems found. May be an empty list.

strengths.description: Short statements of what already works.

notes.description: Optional. What could not be assessed and why. May be empty.

extra.description: Optional extra text blocks shown on the page.

result.description: How the site fares on this criterion.

weight.description: Whole-number weight; all weights in the file sum to 100.

key.description: Unique id in lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Other text refers to it as [[key]]. Never type a report ID such as MSG-01; the builder assigns those.

issue.description: What is wrong, in plain words.

impact_text.description: Why it matters to the goal of the site.

impact.description: Business impact from 1 (low) to 5 (high). 3-5 counts as high.

effort.description: Work needed from 1 (little) to 5 (a lot). 1-2 counts as low.

evidence.description: Optional. What was seen, such as a quote or a measured value. May be empty.

measured.description: Optional, default false. True only when a scan file in the run folder backs the finding; the builder rejects it otherwise.

fix_brief.description: Optional shorter version of fix. When empty or missing, the builder shortens fix itself.
